name: Ingredients for the Forge
objectiveText: Bring 10 Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue . Bronze Bar  ( 10 )

comments.body:
I completed this quest as a Miner in Loch Modan. I'm not sure if it requires the profession. The [b]quest giver stands right next to a forge[/b], so you can smelt your ore into bars right then and there.

The reward is deceptively massive: [b]25s[/b] is already close to what the Bronze Bars themselves are worth, but you also get [b]2450 XP[/b] from this. The XP reward is about [b]twice[/b] as much as regular level ~15 quests. Since you'll also have way more Copper than Tin, this quest doesn't really put a dent in your Bronze Bar supply as you can use the reward to craft more.
